== Course of events ==

Having learned the magic words from Old Mombi, Tip speaks them aloud, and the Thing comes to life. It responds violently, screeching and flapping its wings with great force.

The animation marks the moment the assembled creation ceases to be an inert construction and becomes a living, willful thing, its harsh cries and thrashing wings signaling an unruly nature from the very first instant of its existence.
